scope_note: v0.26 stage-1 (regtest) readiness only. Protocol §13.1 permits deterministic fixtures at this stage and assigns zero economic value to it. Passing every check means the graph and connector behave correctly against real Bitcoin Core under fixtures. It establishes nothing about the security floor, release profile, ceremony, proof suite, or funds, and it is not signet readiness — stage 2 additionally requires production binaries, topology, policy, and the ceremony path. It must never be cited as evidence of funds safety.
